```sql
WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        COALESCE(quantity, 0) AS quantity_filled
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock >= DATE '2023-08-17'
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        quantity_filled,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(last_restock), store_id ORDER BY last_restock, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_quantity,
        LEAD(quantity_filled, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS next_quantity_filled
    FROM valid
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
ranked_inventory AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY running_quantity, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.brand,
        b.price,
        b.product_name
    FROM ranked_inventory a
    LEFT JOIN products b
        ON a.product_id = b.id
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    id,
    product_id,
    measure,
    metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        next_quantity_filled,
        quantity_filled,
        price
    FROM enriched
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR measure IN (next_quantity_filled AS NEXT_QUANTITY_FILLED, quantity_filled AS QUANTITY_FILLED, price)
)
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= F.lit("2023-08-17").cast("date"))
    .select(

        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        F.coalesce("quantity", F.lit(0)).alias("quantity_filled"),

)

    .select(

        "product_id",
        "quantity",

        F.lead("quantity_filled", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")).alias("next_quantity_filled"),
    )

    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))

enriched = (
```

```sql
with exploded as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        created_at,
        line.product_id,
        line.qty,
        line.promo
    from (
        select
            id,
            created_at,
            explode(items) as line
        from carts
    ) t
),
scored as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        created_at,
        rank() over (order by qty nulls last) as qty_rank,
        max(product_id) over w_recent as created_at_to_date_max_product_id,
        avg(qty) over w_recent as created_at_to_date_avg_qty
    from exploded
    window w_recent as (partition by to_date(created_at), promo)
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        qty_rank,
        created_at_to_date_max_product_id,
        created_at_to_date_avg_qty,
        sum(qty_rank) over (order by cast(created_at as bigint) range between 900 preceding and current row) as qty_rank_sum_15m,
        avg(created_at_to_date_max_product_id) over (order by cast(created_at as bigint) range between 3600 preceding and current row) as created_at_to_date_max_product_id_avg_1h,
        percent_rank() over (order by created_at_to_date_max_product_id desc nulls first) as created_at_to_date_max_product_id_percent_rank,
        rank() over (order by qty_rank desc) as qty_rank_rank
    from scored
),
scored_carts as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        rank() over (order by created_at_to_date_avg_qty) as created_at_to_date_avg_qty_rank,
        percent_rank() over (order by created_at_to_date_max_product_id_avg_1h desc nulls first) as created_at_to_date_max_product_id_avg_1h_percent_rank
    from metrics
),
valid as (

    from scored_carts
    where created_at_to_date_avg_qty_rank > 8
```
